Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Valley Market is a full-service supermarket offering a wide range of fresh produce, dairy, meats, and grocery items, with an emphasis on quality and customer satisfaction. Our operations include maintaining a clean and safe shopping environment, adhering to strict food safety regulations, and providing excellent customer service. We have implemented a robust risk management program, including regular safety audits and employee training on food handling and sanitation practices. Our store spans over 5,000 square feet, allowing us to efficiently manage inventory and reduce the risk of spoilage. Additionally, we have implemented security measures to prevent theft and protect our assets. We do not sell used goods or offer on-site fuel sales, thereby minimizing additional environmental and liability risks.
